feedback: The candidate is a faithful, compact encoding of the task and passes all checks. (1) Semantic fidelity: the success chain is encoded as ordered transitions u0 --has_door_key--> u1 --door_open--> u2 --target_picked_up--> u3, matching 'acquire the matching key before opening the door' and 'open the door before picking up the target box' and the environment constraints. The soft prohibition 'do not drop the key while the door is still closed' maps exactly onto the event proposition key_lost, which is penalized (-0.3) in every state where it can fire: u1 (drop before ever opening, with explicit regression to u0) and u2 (reachable only after the agent re-closes the door; penalized in place). Since opening the door is mandatory for the box, penalizing key_lost outright is behaviorally equivalent to penalizing the 'both X and Y' combination. (2) Reward safety: the required drop after opening (door_open true, so key_lost does not fire) falls to (u2, else) -> u2 with no penalty — correctly unpenalized, verified against the example trace (step 9 drop earns 0). Keeping the RM in u2 on the u2 key_lost case is reward-safe: a regression to u0 there would make the prohibited detour profitable (-0.3 + 0.1 + 0.4 = +0.2 via double door_open reward); instead re-entry into u1 after the u1 regression costs -0.3 + 0.1 = -0.2 net, so no positive farming exists anywhere (u1->u2 and u2->u3 fire at most once; u2 is one-way). (3) Progress rewards are dense (0.1/0.4/1.0 at milestones) and bounded (total 1.5; negative accumulation bounded by the 288-step limit). (4) Irrelevant/impossible propositions in each state (door_open and target_picked_up in u0, target_picked_up in u1, has_door_key and door_open re-firings in u2, post-terminal steps in u3) are absorbed by per-state else self-loops; the event/persistent distinction is respected since key_lost is consumed as a one-step event. (5) Format: header complete — nonempty FINAL_STATES: u3, declared in STATES and accepting (reached only via target_picked_up, the episode-ending step); INITIAL_STATE declared; labels are predicate-only or else; REWARD_FUNCTION lists all nonzero transition rewards with the triple (source, label, target), zero else self-loops omitted per convention. Minor non-blocking notes: the +0.1 re-entry reward into u1 after a key_lost regression slightly offsets the penalty (net -0.2 per drop/re-pick cycle, still net negative and safe), and the penalty on key_lost applies even if the door is never subsequently opened — an acceptable operationalization of the soft 'try not to' constraint.
